description: Wave 4a: GravityGun on 2 windowed F2F 0.32 clients. A (hotbar key 2, aim, LMB via F2F input) grabs a bench; the world decides (one holder) and moves it with A's look/position (ToolUse aim); B sees the holder (EntityOwnership) and cannot grab (RequestReply 8); A releases (LMB); final positions of A and B equal the world's; then B grabs (0) and releases. Consistency 0. UX A1: the bench's `move` right is set to everyone (default since A1: owner only) — B may grab after A releases.
